Replace lines 78–88, retaining hfy and hcy, with:
    dsimp only [G]

findings.benefit: The proof directly expresses the mathematical idea: substitute the local extensions, then observe that taking the underlying sphere value commutes with the conditional. The explicit simplification list avoids opaque automation and works uniformly for q = 0 and all translation parameters.

def translate (c : ℂ) (x : StandardSphere2) : StandardSphere2 :=
  ⟨ambient c x.1, ambient_mem_sphere c x⟩

theorem apply_ite (f : α → β) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] (x y : α) :
    f (ite P x y) = ite P (f x) (f y) :=
  apply_dite f P (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y)
